cross_provision_findings.headline: Tenant has no express right or formula protecting against escalation.
cross_provision_findings.detail: Landlord controls all rent terms with no tenant right to limit increases or formula protection.

cross_provision_findings.headline: Tenant's renewal right is conditional and rent is left open.
cross_provision_findings.detail: Landlord retains sole discretion over extension rent; tenant renewal right is conditional with rent left open.

cross_provision_findings.headline: Tenant must restore deposit and has limited recourse on return timing.
cross_provision_findings.detail: Landlord may apply deposit unilaterally; tenant must restore with limited recourse on return timing.

cross_provision_findings.headline: Tenant has no co-tenancy or continuous operation relief.
cross_provision_findings.detail: Landlord enforces strict use limitation; tenant has no co-tenancy or continuous operation relief.

cross_provision_findings.headline: Tenant has no defined landlord structural repair rights or timelines.
cross_provision_findings.detail: Landlord may perform tenant repairs and charge as additional rent; tenant has no defined landlord structural repair rights or timelines.

cross_provision_findings.headline: Tenant pays estimated share without audit or annual cap.
cross_provision_findings.detail: Landlord estimates and reconciles CAM unilaterally; tenant pays without audit or annual cap.

cross_provision_findings.headline: Tenant must carry coverage without reciprocal business interruption protection.
cross_provision_findings.detail: Landlord requires high limits and additional insured status; tenant carries coverage without reciprocal business interruption protection.

cross_provision_findings.headline: Tenant has no automatic affiliate transfer right or profit allocation.
cross_provision_findings.detail: Landlord may withhold consent in sole discretion for most transfers; tenant has no automatic affiliate transfer right or profit allocation.

cross_provision_findings.headline: Tenant must obtain approval and bears all removal risk at end of term.
cross_provision_findings.detail: Landlord may withhold consent in absolute discretion; tenant must obtain approval and bears all removal risk.

cross_provision_findings.headline: Tenant receives limited protection only for landlord gross negligence.
cross_provision_findings.detail: Landlord receives broad indemnity; tenant receives limited protection only for landlord gross negligence.

cross_provision_findings.headline: Tenant receives no rent abatement or termination right after prolonged event.
cross_provision_findings.detail: Landlord may extend its own performance deadlines; tenant receives no rent abatement or termination right after prolonged event.

cross_provision_findings.headline: Tenant signage limited to door and one directory listing.
cross_provision_findings.detail: Landlord may remove non-approved signs at tenant expense; tenant signage limited to door and one directory listing.

cross_provision_findings.headline: Tenant has no express parking rights or remedies.
cross_provision_findings.detail: Landlord has no obligation to provide or maintain parking; tenant has no express parking rights or remedies.

cross_provision_findings.headline: Tenant has no defined dispute resolution path or forum.
cross_provision_findings.detail: Landlord benefits from jury waiver in all disputes; tenant has no defined dispute resolution path or forum.

cross_provision_findings.headline: Tenant has no exclusive use right or remedy.
cross_provision_findings.detail: Landlord may lease to competing tenants without restriction; tenant has no exclusive use right or remedy.

cross_provision_findings.headline: Tenant must attorn without receiving non-disturbance protection.
cross_provision_findings.detail: Mortgagee rights are automatically superior; tenant must attorn without receiving non-disturbance protection.

cross_provision_findings.headline: Tenant may terminate only after 180 days and must continue rent otherwise.
cross_provision_findings.detail: Landlord may terminate without repair obligation; tenant may terminate only after 180 days and must continue rent otherwise.

cross_provision_findings.headline: Tenant may only recover moving expenses from authority.
cross_provision_findings.detail: Landlord receives all condemnation award; tenant may only recover moving expenses from authority.

cross_provision_findings.headline: Tenant has no express constructive eviction remedy.
cross_provision_findings.detail: Landlord's covenant is subject to tenant's full compliance; tenant has no express constructive eviction remedy.

cross_provision_findings.headline: Tenant has zero remedies against landlord default.
cross_provision_findings.detail: Landlord has full default remedies including termination and re-entry; tenant has zero remedies against landlord default.

cross_provision_findings.headline: Tenant must comply with all laws at its sole cost.
cross_provision_findings.detail: Landlord has no compliance duties at commencement or for structure; tenant must comply with all laws at its sole cost.

cross_provision_findings.headline: Tenant must respond in 10 days with no limit on requests.
cross_provision_findings.detail: Landlord may request estoppel at any time with broad content; tenant must respond in 10 days with no limit on requests.

cross_provision_findings.headline: Detailed landlord default/remedy/self-help chain in Article 15 with no parallel landlord-default framework or tenant remedies.
cross_provision_findings.detail: Article 15 (full landlord remedies) vs. no landlord default section (LP-27 0/10) | Article 15 (Sections 15.1-15.7) vs. no landlord default article

cross_provision_findings.headline: Reconciliation credit right exists but no audit, dispute, offset or default remedy to enforce it; rent payable without setoff.
cross_provision_findings.detail: Section 3.3 (no audit) and LP-27 (0/10) | Section 3.3, Section 3.1 (no setoff), LP-27 (0/10)

cross_provision_findings.headline: Automatic subordination and attornment without non-disturbance covenant or mortgagee recognition rights.
cross_provision_findings.detail: Section 21.1 (automatic subordination) and limited Section 18.1 quiet enjoyment | Section 21.1 (automatic subordination), limited Section 18.1

cross_provision_findings.headline: Adverse events leave tenant paying full rent with only narrow casualty termination and no abatement/offset/self-help.
cross_provision_findings.detail: Section 10.1, Section 24.11 (rent excluded), LP-27 (0/10) | Section 10.1, Section 6.2, Section 24.11, Section 23.4, LP-27 (0/10) | Section 10.1, Section 6.2, Section 24.11, Section 3.1, LP-27 (0/10)

cross_provision_findings.headline: Service or access impairments possible while rent remains due and no self-help, offset or default remedy exists.
cross_provision_findings.detail: Section 6.2, Section 10.1, partial LP-06/LP-14 | Section 6.2, Section 10.1, Section 23.4, LP-27 (0/10) | Section 6.2, Section 23.4, LP-27 (0/10)
